# readtheplan

> Free, MIT-licensed infrastructure change-risk analysis for humans and coding agents.

readtheplan analyzes Terraform/OpenTofu plan JSON and many other infrastructure,
CI/CD, policy, and configuration artifacts without executing them or contacting
infrastructure. It classifies changes as safe, review, dangerous, or irreversible
and can map findings to six built-in compliance catalogs.

CI/CD analysis includes GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Azure Pipelines,
Bitbucket Pipelines, Buildkite, Travis CI, Drone CI, and Woodpecker CI.
Self-hosted CI coverage also includes Concourse pipelines, Bamboo YAML Specs,
Jenkins/JCasC, and TeamCity Kotlin DSL.
Cloud-native delivery coverage includes AWS CodeBuild buildspecs, Google Cloud
Build configurations, and AWS CodePipeline definitions.
Secrets supply-chain coverage includes SOPS creation policy and encrypted
YAML, JSON, dotenv, and INI metadata without decrypting secret values.
Container build supply-chain coverage includes Docker Buildx Bake HCL/JSON and
Compose-backed build graphs without invoking Buildx or contacting registries.
Terraform Stacks coverage includes `.tfcomponent.hcl` and `.tfdeploy.hcl`
provenance, lifecycle, approval, identity, store, and cross-Stack data boundaries.
Kubernetes infrastructure-controller coverage includes Cluster API cluster,
machine, control-plane, bootstrap, remediation, and provider lifecycles plus
Karpenter node provisioning, disruption, cloud identity, image, and networking.
Ansible coverage includes playbooks, controller configuration, Galaxy dependencies,
static YAML/INI inventory, and dynamic inventory plugin configuration without
executing plugins, resolving Vault values, contacting APIs, or connecting to hosts.
Puppet coverage includes manifests, Puppetfile/module metadata, Hiera configuration,
and duplicate-safe puppet.conf analysis for agent, server, CA, trust, execution,
cached-catalog, plugin, reporting, identity, endpoint, and credential settings.

Use `readtheplan scan .` to discover supported infrastructure files across a
repository and return one aggregate gate with per-file analyzer results.
Local MCP clients can call `agent_gate_project` for the same repository gate;
set `MCP_ROOT` so candidate files are confined and analyzed from an isolated snapshot.

Every product feature is free. There is no paid tier, enterprise tier, trial,
product account, or hosted raw-plan upload workflow.

- Source and issues: https://github.com/readtheplan/readtheplan

## Data boundary

Local tools process infrastructure artifacts on the user's machine or CI runner.
The optional website chat is separate, sends chat messages to DeepSeek, and must
not be used for secrets or raw infrastructure plans.

## Content use

Search indexing and live AI retrieval with attribution are welcome. Permission to
use this site's content for model training is not granted by the site's published
Content-Signal directive.
